story.purpose: The sound of Paravoxia is a correct chord on a bedroom synth, playing beside the game rather than in it. This run makes sound a fidelity of the same ladder the eye climbs: an instrument with weight, one mix where a stone landing is heard against the bed, awakenings the music lands rather than approaches, a world that sounds where and of what it is, an hour that was composed, and an institution that finally speaks in the fidelity the player has earned and still never says who it is.
story.emotionalBefore: Correct and thin. The player believes the music is a layer beside the game, and every mix complaint they could make is a complaint they cannot prove.
story.emotionalAfter: Inhabited. The player hears the same ladder they are looking at, and the sound is telling the truth about where they are and what has been earned. Nothing has been told to them that was not already on the screen.
story.intendedAmbiguity: Who is speaking, and whether the world speaks at all. The voice bus gives the institution a timbre and no identity; the marker keeps the REGULATION family so guidance never reads as a thing in the world; the klaxon from the wreck stays centred until its visual member exists. Every one of those is a place where the run could have answered the question and refused to.
nonNegotiableCanon: the era ladder is the only fidelity gate: no beat id ever unlocks fidelity, for music, SFX width, room or voice
state is never delayed for sound: milestones, advanceToBeat, commits and receipts fire at the arming tick
the presentation bundle chases audioTime as one unit and no member is ever split
no stage raises a floor the composer lowered
the EARLY-LADDER CALM LAWS: sub at or under 0.10, three rests per bar, at or under 112 BPM before A2
the harmony brain legality model and the voice-leading law
the SYMPHONY LAW start-anchored slews and the smoothness battery, whose thresholds may only tighten
the world-clock tick on its own timeline
the oxygen body clock, non-quantized and protected as shipped
the sfxRateLimiter loop-guard thresholds as the backstop, unretuned
the audioCore music topology, ramp semantics, iOS route and armed-until-confirmed unlock
the frozen story audio contracts setScoreBeat, setScoreIntensity, scoreHit and unlockStoryScore, and Chapter authorship of the MOODS
the un-stung first direction at the Maw: no hit may be added there
the ch10 carrier design and its octave-double filter; the station has no key and no brain may walk it home
the a4-exhale cue is a bloom and never a braam: this is arrival, not victory
the hidden pillar is planted and never told; nothing in this run may resolve which reading is true
the voice is a fidelity of the terminal, not a character

events.event: The feed reassigns its tracking view at ch1-track entry; the shipped bloom acknowledges a task issued, and the camera unbolts.
events.playerAction: The player completed the fixed-cell work order; the beat entry follows the act.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. The bloom is the feed acknowledging that the tracking view is reassigning.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The bloom onset is within 1 ms of the returned audioTime and the camera unbolt starts within -1/+2 rendered frames of it, with the completing player input timestamped before frame -1.

events.event: The first awakening lands: colour stabilises and the reality stage steps from bare to color.
events.playerAction: The player has ridden the a1 ramp to its end; nothing is asked of them at the landing.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. The image owns this awakening and the bloom may not lead it.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The stage cut fires at max(A1_RAMP_SECONDS end, bundleAt) and the bloom onset is within 1 ms of the returned audioTime; the image never precedes the onset.

events.event: The second awakening starts: the feed wall falls and the frame hands the player their own field of view.
events.playerAction: The player has waited out the HUD death; the liberation is authored, not earned by input.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. The braam is the wall failing, and it must not fall before the HUD death it answers.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The braam is scheduled with a caller-supplied notBefore equal to the HUD-death beat-clock fact converted at arming, so it can never precede it; onset within 1 ms of audioTime.

events.event: The a2 hand-back: look mode goes free, the render treatment clears, and the chapter hands control back.
events.playerAction: None required; the hand-back is the authored end of the awakening.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. Control returning is the whole statement.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Every member of the hand-back bundle moves on the one stored target; no member is split, and control is free within -1/+2 frames of the onset.

events.event: The descent ends in impact: two shipped scoreHit calls that are one onset and are never split.
events.playerAction: None; the fall is authored and must read for its full 4.5 seconds before it lands.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. The impact is the raster era failing to contain an event.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The 'impact' kind renders boom and braam at one audioTime; the flash bundle has one master; the bound is one-sided so the impact may only move later.

events.event: Mid-lift, perspective is issued: the DPR snap, its masking glitch and the braam are one indivisible bundle.
events.playerAction: None; the lift is authored and the snap is a render event the player is protected from seeing raw.
events.informationRevealed: No new information beyond the shipped line 'PERSPECTIVE IS BEING ISSUED.' which is already on screen.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The masked-snap bundle is never split: glitch, storyGlitch, the DPR release and the braam share one stored target, and the image is never more than one frame early.

events.event: The a3 wave starts: the world gains material, one blade first.
events.playerAction: None; the hold before the wave is authored as a hold and the grain captions land inside it.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. The wave is the material rung of the ladder arriving.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The scheduler takes notBefore equal to wakeAt plus the last A3_CAPTIONS atSeconds plus one 8th step, so the stretched wave can never precede the last grain caption; the strip verifies it rather than guarding it.

events.event: The a3 landing: material becomes the reality stage and the reveal wave is cleared in the same frame.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. Material is earned, not announced.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The stage cut and clearLifeReveal() stay simultaneous on one stored target, so no pop is possible; the cut fires at max(timeline end, bundleAt).

events.event: The Maw answers a committed repair. The commit and its receipt are immediate; only the answer may take a breath.
events.playerAction: The player committed the repair; the answer follows the act and never precedes it.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. The un-stung first direction at the Maw is canon and no hit is added there.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The receipt and commit fire at the arming tick; the answer chases the returned audioTime; no hit exists at the un-stung first direction.

events.event: The fourth awakening: the world exhales and the alive stage commits.
events.playerAction: The player kept the vigil; the commit is immediate and only the presentation chases.
events.informationRevealed: No new information. This is arrival, not victory, and the cue must remain a bloom.
events.acceptanceCriterion: commitA4Alive fires immediately at the arming tick; storyAwaken, the caption and the lifeProgress origin move as one bundle on the stored target; the cue is a bloom at every run.

cinematography.thesis: The eye and the ear change in the same frame, and neither gets a fidelity the other has not earned. This run authors no shot, no camera authority, no FOV and no post effect; it moves the tick that ten shipped bundles land on, and it pays two accessibility debts with one frame of ember and one HUD surface. Sound-caption presentation is bound by reference, not restated (cinematography condition C3): as recorded in cinematography-treatment.md section 3.2 and cinematography-recon-01 CN-R3/CN-R4, both verified in director-notes.jsonl - uppercase, the audit band's mono 12 px / 0.14em tracking, a 1.2 s hold and a 300 ms fade (hard show/hide under reduced motion), one caption per cue kind at a time, never bottom-centre; the literal tokens are [ALARM] [STATIC] [IMPACT] [HATCH] with [GLITCH] refused, authored by Chapter in soundCaptionTable.ts and rendered by SoundCaption.tsx; VOICE_SILENT_BEATS is imported by reference from one exported runtime constant plus the ch1-lift entry, never copied. Integration implements those, not a reinterpretation of the lowercase family names in the Stage 6 parity clause.
